label: Yucatán: Mérida whole, the south and the east
why: Mérida's zone (mia) wrapped the Kanasín zone (kax), a strip from Kanasín, part of Mérida's built-up area (48% of its commutes cross its line), down to the Puuc towns; Felipe Carrillo Puerto's zone (fel) ran from Quintana Roo up Yucatán's east and into a pocket 40 km from Mérida. kax is retired into Mérida (Kanasín, Timucuy, Tecoh); fel becomes the south: the Puuc and cone towns (Ticul, Oxkutzcab, Tekax, Peto, Maxcanú) with Felipe Carrillo Puerto and José María Morelos; a new zone vdd takes the east round Valladolid and Tizimín with Mérida's far east (Izamal, Río Lagartos). Mérida keeps the north-west and its ring.
